meta.name: provenance
meta.description: 收集系统全链路操作日志，生成可追溯的执行证据链与向量索引，是多智能体系统可观测性与安全审计的底座。

counter.description: 静态文本估算: CJK 字符 + 拉丁词 + 符号混合计数;不代表任一模型真实 tokenizer。单文本文件 >256KB 或 symlink 逃逸包外的不计入。

copy.tagline: 追踪系统的每一步操作，留作可审计的证据链
copy.fit_line: 适合你,如果在维护多智能体系统，需要完整操作日志做安全审计
copy.tagline_en: Trace every operation across your system to build an auditable evidence chain
copy.fit_line_en: For you if you maintain a multi-agent system and need full operation logs for security audit

howto.what: 把各模块的分发、扫描、解析、卡片生成等关键操作事件收进证据链，生成按 trace_id 串联的可追溯记录和向量索引，并提供按 trace_id、时间窗、模块等条件的检索接口。它只负责留痕与审计支撑，不改动用户任务。
howto.when: 当其他模块在关键操作节点调用它，或通过事件总线推送操作事件时触发。

say.text: 把刚才的分发与解析事件记入证据链。
say.note: 会按 trace_id 追加留痕记录。

say.text: 按 trace_id 查一下这条任务的完整操作日志。
汇总今天各模块的操作事件。
say.note: 按时间窗检索并输出摘要。

howto.what_en: Records dispatch, scan, parse and card-generation events from modules into a chained evidence trail by trace_id, maintains a vector index, and offers retrieval by trace_id, time window, module, etc. It only handles tracing and audit support, not user tasks.
howto.when_en: Triggers when another module calls it at a key operation step or pushes an event through the event bus.

say_en.text: Log the dispatch and parse events just now into the evidence chain.
Look up the full operation trail for this trace_id.
Summarize operational events from modules for today.
say_en.note: Queries by time window and outputs a summary.
